Returns the torque needed to achieve a given angular acceleration on this part's assembly, optionally accounting for gyroscopic effects.
The desired angular acceleration vector in world space.
The current angular velocity of the assembly in world space. Defaults to (0, 0, 0). Supply the assembly's angular velocity to account for gyroscopic effects.

Returns the angular acceleration that would result from applying a given torque to this part's assembly, optionally accounting for gyroscopic effects.
The torque vector applied to the assembly in world space.
The current angular velocity of the assembly in world space. Defaults to (0, 0, 0). Supply the assembly's angular velocity to account for gyroscopic effects.
A Vector3 representing the resulting angular acceleration in world space.

descriptions.before: Displays how many hinges are detected by the VehicleSeat. Useful for debugging vehicle designs.
descriptions.after: Displays how many hinges are detected by the VehicleSeat. Useful for debugging vehicle designs.

descriptions.before: If true, a fancy speed bar will be displayed speed on screen that tells you what speed the Vehicle is moving at.
descriptions.after: If true, a UI speed bar will be displayed on screen that tells you what speed the vehicle is moving at.

descriptions.before: The humanoid that is sitting in the seat.
descriptions.after: The Humanoid that is sitting in the seat.

descriptions.before: The direction of movement, tied to the keys A and D. Must be one of 1 (right), 0 (straight), or -1 (left). Will refresh back to 0 unless constantly set.
descriptions.after: The direction of movement, tied to left and right movement inputs.

descriptions.before: Functions identically to VehicleSeat.Steer, but the value is not an integer.
descriptions.after: The left-to-right movement float, tied to left and right movement inputs.

descriptions.before: The direction of movement, tied to the keys W and S. Must be an integer 1 (forward) 0 (null) or -1 (reverse). Will refresh back to 0 unless constantly set.
descriptions.after: The direction of throttle, tied to forward and backward movement inputs.

descriptions.before: Functions identically to VehicleSeat.Throttle, but the value is not an integer.
descriptions.after: The forward-to-reverse throttle float, tied to forward and backward movement inputs.

descriptions.before: How fast the vehicles will be able to attain VehicleSeat.MaxSpeed. The greater the number, the faster it will reach the maximum speed.
descriptions.after: How fast the vehicle will be able to attain MaxSpeed.

descriptions.before: Used for processing receipts for the user who initiated a Robux transfer. The receipt's PlayerId is the sender's user ID and includes a TransferRequestId field.
descriptions.after: Used for processing receipts for the user who initiated a Robux transfer. The receipt's PlayerId is the sender's user ID and includes a TransferRequestId field. Delivered immediately if no receiver approval was required, otherwise deferred until the sender's next session join.

descriptions.before: Used for processing receipts for the user who received Robux via a transfer. The receipt's PlayerId is the receiver's user ID and includes a TransferRequestId field.
descriptions.after: Used for processing receipts for the user who received Robux via a transfer. The receipt's PlayerId is the receiver's user ID and includes a TransferRequestId field. Always deferred until the receiver's next session join.
